scope: Central African Republic medical discovery — Université de Bangui Faculty of Health Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: Université de Bangui's official Medicine page describes a seven-year General Medicine programme over 14 semesters, awarding a State Doctorate in Medicine.
The programme page states that candidates of any nationality with a C or D scientific baccalaureate may enter after passing the first-year entrance examination.
The Central African Republic Prime Minister's office recorded the official start of the 2025/26 academic year at Université de Bangui on 22 October 2025.

holdReasons: No current Medicine tuition, mandatory fees or full cost schedule was located on an official source.
The reviewed Medicine page does not establish a current entrance-exam date, application window, document checklist or complete foreign-applicant procedure.
Teaching language, named clinical partners, current programme recognition/accreditation, accommodation, scholarship/loan support, safety support and graduate-registration pathway are unverified.
nextAction: Obtain the active Faculty of Health Sciences Medicine prospectus, entrance-exam notice and fee decision, then verify teaching language, clinical sites, support and recognition before any payload is prepared.
